tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind every screen; also the typed-answer field fill and the topic-icon block.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, answer rows, secondary buttons and other controls sitting on paper.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Recessed panels: mistake notebook, accent-key row, disabled primary fill. Raised panel in dark.

tokens.name: panel-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet tiles and unselected graded options; due pills.

tokens.name: segment-track
tokens.usage: Backing track of segmented controls (Choose / Type).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on paper, surface, panel and every soft wash.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text, metadata, eyebrows, translations on paper and surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative rules, card hairlines, progress tracks. Never the only outline of a control (below 3:1).

tokens.name: border-ink
tokens.usage: Meaningful control boundaries: answer rows, inputs, secondary buttons, segments (3:1+ on surface).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Teal: primary actions, progress fill, selected edge in dark, focus ring. Also eyebrow text on the featured tile.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Label text on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected answer / selected segment wash, with ink text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px outline at 3px offset on every focusable control, both themes.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Gold: level badges, progress pills, the blank underline in a prompt. Never focus.

tokens.name: sun-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a sun fill.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Streak panel and speak-button backing, with ink text.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Decorative topic outline icons and prose-page eyebrows. Accent, not a state.

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Mistake chips and due pills, with ink or muted text.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Success text and border: correct option edge, “Correct” label, score bar fill.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Success surface behind correct options and feedback, with ink or sage text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and border: wrong option edge, “Not quite” label.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error surface behind wrong options and feedback, with ink or danger text.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Logo mark top block only. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-clay
tokens.usage: Logo mark lower-left block only. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-sun
tokens.usage: Logo mark lower-right block only. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-stroke
tokens.usage: Logo mark 2.5-unit outline. Fixed; in dark the mark sits on a #fffaf3 backing.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: Spanish prompt in a round. 36px at ≤380px.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: Wordmark beside the 24px mark, 8px gap. 18px at ≤380px.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section labels and compact tile titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick the verb that matches the subject.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Short uppercase label above a heading, in muted (primary on the featured tile).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Segment track padding, pill vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Related items, chip gaps, mark-to-wordmark gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Answer row vertical padding, icon-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter; card padding at ≤380px; control horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; featured tile bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separation inside a reveal.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Answer row and primary action minimum height.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Largest layout step.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every control and icon button.

tokens.name: exercise-max
tokens.usage: Max width of quiz, flashcards and results columns.

tokens.name: library-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the library; grid from 768px.

tokens.name: radius-segment
tokens.usage: Level badges, selected segments, accent keys.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, answer rows, inputs, segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Feedback panel, topic-icon block.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Standard cards and topic tiles.

tokens.name: radius-editorial-a
tokens.usage: Editorial corners top-left (18 · 26 · 14 · 26 clockwise): featured tile, question, flashcard, score.

tokens.name: radius-editorial-b
tokens.usage: Editorial corners top-right and bottom-left.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, chips, pills.

tokens.name: shadow-active
tokens.usage: The one active surface per screen: featured tile, question card, score card. Supporting panels stay flat.

tokens.name: motion-feedback
tokens.usage: Hover/press and grading feedback transitions.

tokens.name: motion-reveal
tokens.usage: Feedback panel fade-in and flashcard reveal. Removed under reduced motion.
